handling.title: What is airport handling?
handling.definition: In the aeronautical field, the term handling refers to the set of assistance services carried out at the airport to facilitate aircraft operations. These services cover different activities related to the aircraft, passengers, baggage and cargo, from their arrival at the airport until their departure. Handling makes it possible to coordinate the necessary processes for the movement of passengers, baggage and goods between air and ground transport, as well as connections between aircraft on transit flights. In short, it is the entire set of activities that make it possible for an airport operation to develop in a coordinated, safe and efficient manner.

about.title: About us
about.subtitle: JMC Servicios Especializados
about.intro: We are a Venezuelan company specialized in handling, focused on assistance and platform operations for airlines. We accompany every stage of airport operations, attending to aircraft, passengers, baggage and cargo, with trained personnel and a fleet of ground support equipment (GSE).
about.intro2: We have been present in Maiquetía since 2012 and have the authorization to provide our services since 2015. Our team brings together more than 30 years of experience in the sector, which allows us to understand the demands of each operation and respond in an organized and efficient manner.
about.mission: To be a reference in the Venezuelan airport market, recognized for offering tailored solutions and maintaining high standards of quality, safety and efficiency, evolving alongside the needs of the aeronautical industry.
about.vision: Continue evolving as a reference in airport handling services in Venezuela, maintaining the highest standards of quality, safety and operational efficiency.

equipment.title: Ramp equipment
equipment.subtitle: Complete infrastructure to guarantee safe and efficient aircraft transit on the ramp.
equipment.carruchaDesc: Non-motorized equipment designed to contain and transport passenger baggage, mail or loose cargo. They are linked together forming a train that is pulled between the terminal and the aircraft.
equipment.tractorDesc: Low-profile motorized vehicle with high traction used to pull or tow carts and other small support equipment from airport facilities to the ramp where the aircraft is parked.
equipment.waterDesc: Specialized vehicle responsible for the aircraft lavatory service. It drains and empties the waste tanks of the aircraft and recharges the system with clean water and disinfectant liquid.
equipment.beltDesc: Vehicle equipped with an adjustable conveyor belt that elevates to the cargo hold door of the aircraft. It facilitates the manual loading and unloading of suitcases and bulk cargo, preventing injuries.
equipment.gpuDesc: Ground Power Unit. Provides electrical power to the aircraft while it is parked with engines off. Keeps the aircraft's electrical systems running without consuming fuel.
equipment.asuDesc: Air Start Unit. Provides high-pressure compressed air to assist in starting the aircraft's main engines, indispensable when the APU is inoperative.
